title: Undoing a chat turn puts a WordPress look's Additional CSS back, refuses when it changed since, and the host's copy of the compare-and-set PHP cannot drift from the plugin's
steps: S1: From the TCH checkout run: node --test --test-reporter=tap apps/tracy-web/test/turn-undo.test.mjs apps/tracy-host/test/look-css.test.mjs

S2: Read the result of each test named below. The dsh fork part (atomic writes published relative to the verified parent descriptor) is judged in the fork by packages/fs/fs-local/tests/opened-target.spec.ts on Linux.
expect: 'a WordPress look turn: changed, undoable with the code toolset, its look named; the plan puts it back' passes.
'a look already put back — a look.revert recorded after it, or the host saying so — is undone' passes.

'undo: c0 goes back while the site holds c1, the entry is marked used, and the plugin’s look.revert then refuses it' and 'undo: the Additional CSS changed since (a person saved it) — nothing written, nothing marked' pass.
'🔒 the PHP, its argv, the store and the id shape are the plugin’s own — the copy cannot drift' passes.
fence: Pure plan tests feed a WordPress look turn and later writes; the host job runs against a fake docker exec holding c0/c1 and a person's later save; a drift test imports the site-tools module and compares the PHP, argv, store path and id shape. No model, no network.

tests: a WordPress look turn: changed, undoable with the code toolset
undo: c0 goes back while the site holds c1
undo: the Additional CSS changed since
🔒 the PHP, its argv, the store and the id shape are the plugin’s own
